prompts.primavera: Redesign this oak tree as a production sprite for AlgoLand's refined hand-painted top-down farming RPG. The current reference is REJECTED because it is squat, triangular, too branchy and looks like a bonsai seen from the side. Create ONE natural mature deciduous oak with a FULL ROUNDED DENSE OVAL CANOPY seen from a noticeably ELEVATED orthographic camera looking DOWN at the tree. The round canopy occupies the upper75 percent of the total height; we see its broad top surface. Layered rounded masses of medium forest-green leaves, readable larger leaf clusters, soft selective outline, no yellow glow or high contrast gold speckles. A modest straight warm brown trunk visible only below the lower canopy, narrow subtle root flare touching one ground baseline, NO huge ornamental twisting branches or exposed branches inside the crown. Entire tree taller than wide, visible silhouette WIDTH:HEIGHT approximately 0.69 (72 wide by104 high logical pixels), crown round rather than a pointed fir or pyramid. Light upper left, natural restrained colors, same refinement as cozy illustrated medieval farm houses. Genuine transparent background, clean alpha edges with no red/green matte, no shadow ellipse, no floor, no grass patch, no text or other objects. Portrait canvas1024x1536 with generous transparent margins. The final sprite is512x512 at4x, root pivot256,508; preserve enough clear trunk below the foliage for the12logical-pixel axe cut. Deliver new clean canonical spring model; winter will preserve exact roots and main branches.
prompts.inverno: Create the WINTER version of this EXACT revised oak game sprite. Keep the exact1024x1536 canvas, framing, root outline, trunk position, pivot, total tree height and main branch positions. Remove all leaves from the entire oval canopy, showing a believable living oak network of bare brown branches and fine twigs within the same canopy envelope. Upright modest trunk, same elevated top-down front camera, crisp hand-painted fantasy farming RPG style, light upper left. Add a little white snow physically supported on upper branch/root surfaces. Keep wood brown, NOT red or gold. GENUINELY transparent empty space everywhere between branches and around the whole tree, no colored matte, red fringes, green haze, glow, background, ground patch, shadow, text or other objects. Avoid overly dense twig noise; main branches remain readable at a logical72x104 display size. Preserve lower trunk and roots exactly so seasonal switching does not move or widen the base.
